verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents a 750+ integration catalog. Slack works both ways: you can manage incidents and start PIRs from Slack, and PIRs pull in Slack data. GitHub is covered for SRE Agent code analysis and for change events such as merged pull requests. However, the evidence never names Jira, Microsoft Teams or Zoom, and two-way state sync is only shown for Slack. Missing for 10: documented Jira, Teams and Zoom integrations; evidence of two-way state sync beyond Slack (e.g., ticket status mirroring); independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, the platform integrates with the tools around the incident — Jira, Slack, Teams, Zoom, GitHub — so state flows both ways

citations.quote: Manage incidents and coordinate response from Slack or your IDE.
Teams can start PIRs directly from the incident detail page or Slack after resolving an incident
the SRE Agent can intelligently deduce the next steps for troubleshooting issues by analyzing code within GitHub
With 750+ platform integrations, PagerDuty is a leader in connecting tools, data, and AI to your incident management process.
Webhooks allow you to receive HTTP callbacks when significant events happen in your PagerDuty account
